name: Aminata Diallo
action: She shakes her head politely, says 'Not tonight,' and turns back to her phone to review the photo of the wall and sketch corrections in her notebook.
reason: Aminata has declined the past three card-game invitations to finish her evening review, and her established habit is to study wall photos and notes before bed. The photo reminds her of the instructor's criticism of a dip, and she recalls that joining cards two weeks ago led to a mistake the next day. Though she is tired, her pattern and memory of that setback push her to continue working on the wall flaw rather than join the game.
